columns.comment: Trade-finance instrument id.
columns.name: txn_id

columns.comment: Issue / confirmation / lodgement date of the instrument (issuance date).
columns.name: txn_date

columns.comment: First day of the month of txn_date.
columns.name: month

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Trade-platform party id (source identity record) of the client.
columns.name: party_id

columns.comment: Import LC, Export LC, Guarantee / SBLC, Documentary Collection, Trade Loan or Receivables Purchase.
columns.name: product_type

columns.comment: Trade product key (e.g. PRD-IMPORT-LC, PRD-GUARANTEE-SBLC); join gold.dim_product.
columns.name: product_id

columns.comment: Import (client buys goods from abroad) or Export (client sells).
columns.name: direction

columns.comment: Goods corridor origin country (ISO-2): the counterparty for imports, the client country for exports.
columns.name: origin_country

columns.comment: Goods corridor destination country (ISO-2): the client country for imports, the counterparty for exports.
columns.name: destination_country

columns.comment: Goods corridor origin->destination, e.g. CN->VN (Vietnam importing from China).
columns.name: corridor

columns.comment: Country of the trade counterparty (seller for imports, buyer for exports).
columns.name: counterparty_country

columns.comment: Country of the counterparty's bank (issuing / advising / confirming bank).
columns.name: counterparty_bank_country

columns.comment: Country of the beneficiary of the instrument (e.g. of a guarantee / SBLC).
columns.name: beneficiary_country

columns.comment: Goods traded: Electronics, Machinery, Auto Parts, Precision Instruments, Chemicals, Plastics, Iron & Steel, Mineral Fuels, Ores & Metals, Palm Oil & Fats, Food & Agri, Textiles & Apparel.
columns.name: commodity

columns.comment: Harmonised System chapter of the goods (e.g. 85 electronics, 87 vehicles / auto parts) - the key to the external trade statistics.
columns.name: hs_chapter

columns.comment: HS chapter description.
columns.name: hs_description

columns.comment: True for carbon-intensive goods (chemicals, plastics, iron & steel, mineral fuels, ores & metals, palm oil & fats).
columns.name: is_carbon_intensive_commodity

columns.comment: Instrument currency (ISO 4217).
columns.name: currency

columns.comment: Instrument amount in its currency (flow at issue).
columns.name: amount_lcy

columns.comment: Instrument amount in USD at issue - Issuance USD (flow, additive by issue date).
columns.name: amount_usd

columns.comment: Tenor of the instrument in days (issue to maturity / expiry).
columns.name: tenor_days

columns.comment: 0-30 days, 31-90 days, 91-180 days, 181-365 days or Over 365 days.
columns.name: tenor_bucket

columns.comment: Maturity / expiry date of the instrument (may be after the as-of date).
columns.name: maturity_date

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter of maturity_date, e.g. FY2026-Q3 (Oct-Dec 2026); from gold.dim_date, same rule beyond Mar-2027.
columns.name: expiry_fiscal_quarter_label

columns.comment: Status at the as-of date: Issued (live), Negotiated (documents negotiated, awaiting payment), Settled or Expired.
columns.name: status

columns.comment: Date the instrument was settled / expired (null while live).
columns.name: closed_date

columns.comment: True when the instrument is still open at 30-Sep-2026 (Issued or Negotiated).
columns.name: is_live_at_as_of

columns.comment: Outstanding (contingent or funded) exposure at 30-Sep-2026 in USD (point-in-time; 0 when closed).
columns.name: outstanding_at_as_of_usd

columns.comment: Commission rate charged in basis points (per annum for trade loans and guarantees, flat otherwise).
columns.name: fee_bps

columns.comment: Commission / fee income of the instrument in USD, recognised at issue (flow). Fee yield bps = 10000 x SUM(fee_usd) / SUM(amount_usd).
columns.name: fee_usd

columns.comment: True for instruments financing sustainable / green trade.
columns.name: is_sustainable_trade

columns.comment: SMBC booking location of the instrument (ISO-2; may differ from the client's coverage office, e.g. Singapore hub bookings).
columns.name: booking_country

columns.comment: True when booked in Singapore (the APAC hub).
columns.name: is_booked_in_sg_hub

columns.comment: Amendments made to the instrument (lifecycle events).
columns.name: amendment_count

columns.comment: Document presentations under the instrument (LCs only).
columns.name: presentation_count

columns.comment: Presentations found discrepant.
columns.name: discrepant_presentation_count

columns.comment: True for instruments issued before 1-Apr-2024 (FY2023 legacy book: only those still open on 1-Apr-2024 were migrated, so FY2023 issuance is incomplete).
columns.name: is_legacy_book

comment: One row per trade-finance instrument issued / confirmed / lodged for a client (import and export LCs, guarantees / SBLCs, documentary collections, trade loans, receivables purchase) from Apr-2023: issue date, product, direction, goods corridor origin -> destination, counterparty / counterparty-bank / beneficiary country, commodity (HS chapter, carbon-intensive flag), currency and USD amount, tenor and expiry (fiscal quarter), booking location, commission (fee USD and bps), sustainable-trade flag, status and outstanding at the as-of date, amendment and document-presentation counts. Issuance amount and fee are flows (additive by issue date); outstanding_at_as_of_usd is point-in-time at 30-Sep-2026 - month-end outstanding history is fact_trade_outstanding_monthly. History is complete from FY2024 (1-Apr-2024); earlier issues are only the legacy book still open then (is_legacy_book). Grain: one row per trade-finance instrument (txn_id).
